{{Quote|I need you to oversee the acceptance of a delivery of spice. This is important, because it's being delivered by some Monumenters, and this  is the first time we've worked with them.|[[Jzoro Quanera]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Moving Up|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Monumenters''' were a group of criminals on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were mostly bandits and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{Quote|We'll switch the spice you collected with some poor quality spice that we've diluted with a common medicinal powder. It's unlikely that Jzoro will notice, but even if he does, he'll blame the Monumenters.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize|Baize]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCMU" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Monumenters were in open conflict with the [[Corellian Security Force]] and [[Beldonna's League]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="SonyCite-Faction Standings">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Monumenters attempted to create a criminal partnership with the [[Chirq Council]] to deal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] on Corellia. They organized a meeting near [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] but a CorSec agent infiltrated in the Chirq Council managed to join the meeting. The CorSec agent attacked and killed the participants, and then stole a cargo of spice. The spacer later returned to the Chirq Council underboss [[Jzoro Quanera]] and blamed the Monumenters for killing his men and stealing the spice.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Monumenters are one of many small criminal groups in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. They can be found in the wilderness of the planet Corellia where the game's NPC spawning system occasionally creates small groups of Monumenter bandits, marauders and smugglers. By killing them, the player gains faction standing with CorSec and Beldonna's League.<ref name="SWG" />
